in_tamil.name: Bihari
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Joy
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bihari ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Bihari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhai' meaning brother. The name is associated with Lord Vishnu and signifies the joy and happiness he brings to his devotees.

in_telugu.name: Bihari
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Joy
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bihari ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Bihari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhai' meaning brother. The name is associated with Lord Vishnu and signifies the joy and happiness he brings to his devotees.

in_marathi.name: Bihari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Joy
